# Code map

A generated map of the code: which module depends on which, then each Scala package with its responsibility, entry points, covering test suites and owning decisions. Entry points are names; search for them. Edit `docs/data/codemap.json`, then run `python3 scripts/render_codemap.py`; CI runs it with `--check`.

## Module dependencies

Derived from `dependsOn` in `build.sbt`; an arrow points at what the module builds on.

```
codec      -> (none)
crypto     -> codec
protocol   -> crypto
network    -> protocol
uplc       -> codec, crypto
plutus     -> codec, uplc
ledger     -> protocol, plutus
consensus  -> ledger
storage    -> consensus, models; test only: network
node       -> storage, network
models-gen -> (none)
models     -> codec, crypto; test only: models-gen, protocol, ledger
fuzz       -> codec, protocol, node, models-gen
tools      -> codec, crypto, protocol, network, uplc, plutus, ledger, consensus, storage, node, models
```
